headline: Fresno Pacific outscore every programme in the division
dek: Fresno Pacific's win over Pacific Union carried them past Southwest Baptist, who had scored more than any other side in the division before last night. No side in any conference has scored as many this season, and only the page that sees every conference at once can say so.
